title: Ride-hailing: driver location update
subtitle: Every 4 s per driver, 1.25M per second at peak; nothing on this path touches PostgreSQL

steps.label: loc { seq, ts, lat, lng, hdg, st } over WSS
drop if seq not newer or speed > 250 km/h
stamp server time, H3 res-9 cell, region

steps.section: alt: driver has an active trip (cached on the connection)
consumers, each in its own group

steps.note:
drop if ts not newer than stored
move between cell sets if cell or status changed
evict drivers silent for 30 s
